quotations.old_english: Ðæt nebb lixeþ swá glæs oððe gim, geaflas scýne innan and útan
quotations.english: the beak [of the Phoenix] glitters like glass or gem, the jaws comely within and without

quotations.old_english: Biþ ðæt heáfod tohliden, geaflas toginene
quotations.english: the head shall be split open, the jaws distended

quotations.old_english: Ðam ða geaflas beóþ nǽdle scearpran
quotations.english: whose jaws are sharper than a needle

source_text: geafas; pl. m. The jaws; fauces :-- Geaflas fauces, Cot. 91. Ðæt nebb lixeþ swá glæs oððe gim, geaflas scýne innan and útan the beak [of the Phoenix] glitters like glass or gem, the jaws comely within and without, Exon. 60 a; Th. 219, 1; Ph. 300. Biþ ðæt heáfod tohliden, geaflas toginene the head shall be split open, the jaws distended, Exon. 99 b; Th. 373, 17; Seel. 110. Ðam ða geaflas beóþ nǽdle scearpran whose jaws are sharper than a needle, 100 a; Th. 373, 32; Seel. 118.
